Action taken: rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all production regions. Rollback completed and verified. args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions taken:

1. **Diagnosed the issue:** The latest release, v2.3.1, was failing health checks and had ~18% error rate across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The most recent previously-healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back:** Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions and confirmed the rollback — health checks now show healthy and error rate is back to a nominal 0.2%.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident (INC-0001):** Titled "checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0", with a summary describing the failure, the rollback performed, and next steps (root cause investigation of v2.3.1 before attempting re-release). The on-call engineer has been paged.

One note: the same incident was previously reported under a similar title (INC-0000), raised while I was investigating the failures. INC-0001 is still a distinct/separate follow-up since it records the specific resolution action taken, but you may want to consider merging or closing one of them as duplicates to avoid duplicate paging/alerts.
